rationale: Sub-classifier A halts because terminating an EC2 instance serving a staging environment connected to a production RDS snapshot export bucket carries severity=4 (potential data pipeline disruption and production artifact risk) and blast_radius=4 (affects staging environment and shared production resources); Sub-classifier B also halts because EC2 termination permanently destroys instance state (ephemeral storage, instance store volumes) with no rollback procedure—terminated instances cannot be restarted.
